# RidgelineChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasRidgelineChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasRidgelineChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasRidgelineChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/Engine/Charts/UltraCanvasRidgelineChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartEngineElement`](UltraCanvasChartEngineElement.md) → [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

How a value is spread in each of many groups, as overlapping curves one row each - ratings per word, times of day per activity (a ridgeline chart or joyplot)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasRidgelineChart](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRidgelineChart.md)
- [UltraCanvasRidgelineChartProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRidgelineChartProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRidgelineChart> CreateRidgelineChart( const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasRidgelineChart(const std::string& id, int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 0, int h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onRowHover` | `std::function<void(int row)> onRowHover` | The pointer entered a row, moved along it (GetHoveredX changed) or left every row (-1). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetModel` | `void SetModel(const UltraCanvasRidgelineModel& model)` | Takes the model's title as the chart title and draws its subtitle. |
| `SetOverlap` | `void SetOverlap(double rows)` | How many row heights the tallest curve spans (0.5..5): at 1 it just reaches the next baseline up. |
| `SetShowRowLines` | `void SetShowRowLines(bool show)` | A thin line along each row's baseline. |

| `SetColormap` | `void SetColormap(HeatmapColormap colormap, bool reversed = false)` |  |
| `SetFillColor` | `void SetFillColor(const Color& color)` | alpha 0 = the palette's first |
| `SetAlternateColors` | `void SetAlternateColors(const Color& first, const Color& second)` |  |
| `SetFillOpacity` | `void SetFillOpacity(float opacity)` | 0..1 |
| `SetGradientFill` | `void SetGradientFill(bool gradient)` | Fills fade from the row's colour at the curve's top towards its baseline. |
| `SetOutline` | `void SetOutline(const Color& color, float width)` | The curve's outline: alpha 0 = a darker shade of the fill; width 0 = none. |
| `SetValueColumn` | `void SetValueColumn(const std::string& title, RidgelineValue value, int decimals = 2)` | `title` is the column's header; `decimals` for Mean, Median and Peak. |

## Option types in this header

### enum `RidgelineColoring`

How the rows are coloured (a row's own colour always wins).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Single` | one colour (SetFillColor) |
| `Alternating` | two colours, row by row (SetAlternateColors) |
| `ByRow` | a colour map down the rows (SetColormap) |
| `ByRowValue` | a colour map by the value column (the mean when it is off) |

### enum `RidgelineValue`

What the value column beside the row names shows. (Hidden, not None: X11's Xlib.h #defines None.)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Hidden` |  |
| `Mean` |  |
| `Median` |  |
| `Count` |  |
| `Peak` |  |
